definitions.gloss: next time, next occasion, next installment
definitions.explanation: The next occurrence of a recurring event, meeting, episode, or session. Used for anything that happens in a series or cycle.

examples.japanese: {次回|じかい}は{来週|らいしゅう}です。
examples.english: The next session is next week.

examples.japanese: {次回|じかい}の{会議|かいぎ}までに{資料|しりょう}を{準備|じゅんび}してください。
examples.english: Please prepare the materials by the next meeting.

examples.japanese: {次回|じかい}{予告|よこく}を{見|み}たら、{来週|らいしゅう}の{展開|てんかい}がとても{気|き}になった。
examples.english: After watching the preview for the next episode, I became very curious about next week's developments.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{次|じ} (next) + {回|かい} (time, round, occasion). Literally "the next round."

USAGE:
Often used as a noun modifier with の: {次回|じかい}の{会議|かいぎ} (the next meeting). Also used without の in compound-like constructions: {次回|じかい}{予告|よこく} (preview of the next episode). Commonly seen at the end of TV shows, manga chapters, and serialized content.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {次回|じかい}の{会議|かいぎ}: the next meeting
- {次回|じかい}{予告|よこく}: preview of the next episode
- {次回|じかい}から: from next time
- {次回|じかい}に{持|も}ち{越|こ}す: to carry over to the next time
- {次回|じかい}{以降|いこう}: from the next time onward

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {今回|こんかい}: this time
- {前回|ぜんかい}: last time
- {毎回|まいかい}: every time
